items.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dennis Mackrel has done two things for me, for this next gig, and Anita Brown has done a couple of things too.

ctx.x: I would imagine that would affect any kind of writing of music.

Yeah, well I have to have somebody, I have to tell them what I want to right. Usually I have people that understand. Dennis Mackrel has done two things for me, for this next gig, and Anita Brown has done a couple of things too. I just explain to them what I have in mind and they know, pretty well, what to do.

You mentioned, with all these people coming through your place and playing with you, having jam sessions, there are a lot of young people learning from you. What’s your sense of your level of playing these days and the state of jazz education?
